text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To master a different running style than 
before, Bitter Glace began a new training 
regimen. However, days of things not going 
as planned continued.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the scene, Little Cocon urged her 
that she should tell Trainer Kashimoto 
about her desire to stay true to her own 
running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering how Trainer Kashimoto had once 
acknowledged her running style, Bitter 
Glace decided to go and consult her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having developed slowly as a late bloomer, 
Happy Meek's true strength was finally 
beginning to blossom after entering the 
Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having persevered since their debut, Happy 
Meek and Trainer Kiryuin devote themselves 
to training as if to make up for lost 
ground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This year, they would achieve what they 
couldn't before—— The two couldn't help 
but hold onto that hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Night—on the deserted training track, 
Happy Meek ran tirelessly in silence, 
picturing their eventual victory.
